_meta.provenance: Figma 'tokens' frame (file Drp803tesW5fIuA2Y21JVx, node 3870:7654) via MCP get_variable_defs, merged with profile frame 2860:2103 for effects/alpha/H1-H2. Raw export: docs/figma-tokens-export.json. Earlier values were traced from the screens/tokens.svg substitute; this revision reconciles them to the Figma source.
_meta.note: Canonical semantic tokens. Names follow the DESIGN_SYSTEM_SPEC taxonomy (namespace/role -> nested namespace.role -> flattened namespace-role); values are Figma variables. Status/category keep the SSOT semantic names (Figma drift: new->open, testing->verification). Alpha tints are stored as rgba() so the parser's hex->rgba pass is a no-op and JSON<->generated stay in sync.
_meta.reconciled: 2026-06-17 — fixed border.default (was #3a3d45=Figma text/disabled -> #5a6070=Figma border/strong) and brand.hover (was #4cacff=color/primary/hover -> #0099ff=Figma brand/hover; the old light tint preserved as brand.highlight). Added text.disabled, brand.highlight, brand.dark-600, accent.pink, overlay.*, effect.shadow.focus/md, effect.backdrop.*, gradient.status-completed-glow, spacing 16(=64px), corner.full. Typography rewritten to real Figma metrics + per-role family + letterSpacing.
_meta.fonts: Resolved (adopt-design-fonts, 2026-06-19): font.family binds the design's sanctioned free-Cyrillic substitution — NKDuy Mono → Handjet (--font-mono), Vremena Grotesk → Manrope (--font-grotesk), SF Compact → system stack (--font-sans); Handjet + Manrope self-host via next/font/google. The F1 type cap is retired (docs/TYPOGRAPHY.md). Type tokens carry the real Figma metrics + per-role family alias (sans/mono).

surface._theme: add-light-theme: `light` siblings build depth via grey layers (app warm-grey → white cards float). Dark = default/unchanged.

level-0.description: Page / darkest background (Figma surface/primary) → light warm-grey app bg

level-1.description: Recessed surface — wells, inner fields (Figma surface/tetriary) → light sunken

level-2.description: Card / input surface, dominant (Figma surface/secondary) → light white card

level-3.description: Elevated surface — gig card base (Figma 'gig bg') → light white card

inverse.description: Chip surface — specialty tag. Dark: white fill. Light: inverts to a dark chip (ТЗ §5) so it reads on white.

logo-plate.description: Logomark backing (light-theme-screen-audit, ТЗ §5): transparent on dark (white mark reads on the dark page), a dark island on light (so the white mark reads on white).

inverse.description: Text on brand/coloured fills — white in BOTH themes (brand stays #0088ff)

muted.description: Muted text & icon strokes (Figma text/secondary) — light darkened to clear WCAG-AA body (≥4.5) on level-0/1

subtle.description: De-emphasized text / progress track — light = muted (AA body on near-white surfaces)

disabled.description: Disabled text (Figma text/disabled — previously mislabeled as border.default)

default.description: Brand primary — CTAs, active, accents (Figma brand/default). THEME-INVARIANT (the brand anchor).

hover.description: Brand hover — dark lightens (+1 step), light DARKENS (ТЗ §4, different hover physics)

highlight.description: Light brand tint — link hover / highlight (Figma color/primary/hover); was previously brand.hover

open.description: Открыт (neutral) — Figma status 'new'; light darkened for AA-large on near-white

review.description: На рассмотрении (amber) — light = amber-700 (vivid amber fails AA on white; hue preserved)

in-progress.description: В работе (blue) — distinct from brand; AA-large both themes

verification.description: На проверке (purple) — Figma status 'testing'; AA-large both themes

completed.description: Завершён (green) — light = emerald-700 (vivid green fails AA on white; hue preserved)

marketing.description: Маркетинг (blue) — Figma Category blue rgb(76,172,255); = brand.highlight, NOT brand.default #0088ff (corrected 2026-06-19)

status-border._note: Per-status 30% border tints (Figma --status-{name}-border). Triad partner of color-semantic.status.* (text) + gradient.status-*-glow (radial). open from Figma status/new (white-based).

pink.description: Accent pink — gig company avatar fill (Figma Accents/Pink)

tint._note: add-light-theme: full-value alpha fills (NOT Tailwind /opacity modifiers, which can't apply to var() colours). brand on light is muted per ТЗ §4. Replaces bg-brand-default/10 + bg-status-rejected/20|30.

brand.description: 10% brand fill — selected option, out-bubble, status pill (light muted, ТЗ §4)

attention._note: Notification-TYPE accents for the AttentionCard (Figma attention card 3367:3916). A DISTINCT palette from status/* — e.g. attention/rejected is neutral gray, not status/rejected red; attention/accepted #16a34a ≠ status/completed #10b981.

rejected.description: Заявка отклонена — neutral gray (NOT status/rejected red)

overlay._theme: add-light-theme: dark = white tints (glow on dark); light = dark tints (hairlines on white), else they vanish.

line-strong.description: Frame border — job card (Figma frame stroke)

font._residual: Fonts adopted as system fact (adopt-design-fonts; docs/TYPOGRAPHY.md) — the design's sanctioned free-Cyrillic substitution: accent NKDuy Mono → Handjet (--font-mono), grotesk Vremena Grotesk → Manrope (--font-grotesk), primary SF Compact → system stack (--font-sans). Handjet + Manrope self-host via next/font/google. Each type role records its family alias (sans/mono); grotesk is available for the Vremena roles (numbers/price/term, message bodies, job-experience), adopted per-screen during the reconciliations.

sans.value: var(--font-sans), -apple-system, system-ui, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

mono.description: Display/data 'accent' — NKDuy Mono (sub: Handjet pixel face)

grotesk.value: var(--font-grotesk), system-ui, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

title.description: Retained — no Figma named style at 16px

shadow._theme: add-light-theme: `light` shadows are navy-tinted + softer (depth via shadow on white, ТЗ §2/§7). focus (brand ring) is theme-invariant.

md.description: Figma Shadow/md — gig card drop shadow (ТЗ §7 light glass→card)

backdrop._note: Backdrop-filter recipes (not box-shadows). Documentation-only — applied in components via Tailwind backdrop-blur utilities; the parser does not emit these.

glass.value: backdrop-blur(16px); box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.08)
glass.description: Figma 'glass' — blurred surface + drop shadow + 2 inner highlights

blur-bg.description: Figma Blur/BG — heavy ambient background blur

brand-glow.description: Layered brand glow — brand/default fill + opacity ramp

status-completed-glow.description: Figma status/completed/bg RADIAL — green glow (dark) → flat 8% fill (light, ТЗ §6)

status-open-glow.description: status/new RADIAL — white glow (dark) → flat neutral fill (light)

corner._note: Complete vs Figma radius scale: xs=2 (Figma lt), sm=4, md=8, lg=12, xl=16 (Figma special), full (Figma radius/full). pill/circular are SSOT extras.
